missed_checkpoints.prompt: Yes, please. We ___ (look) for platform seven since we arrived.
missed_checkpoints.explanation: 'Since' connects a past moment to now, so we need the present perfect: 'We have been looking' (or 'We have looked'). 'We look' or 'We looked' doesn't work with 'since' here.
The announcer said the barriers were out of order and asked passengers to show their tickets to staff at the side gate. The lift is only there to tell you where the gate is.

missed_checkpoints.prompt: What does Sam want you to do when you get to Oxford?
missed_checkpoints.explanation: Sam says not to wait outside, that Rosa at the café knows you're coming, and that Sam will go 'there' (to the café) after work. So Sam expects you to wait at the café, even though the message never says it in one sentence.
